question: What mental placement leads the practitioner to attain the transcendent state beyond mind?
premises: The mind is to be placed in the heart
This placement is maintained over time
The practitioner reaches the state of unmanatā
inference: Fixing the mind in the heart leads to the attainment of the transcendent no-mind state.
plain_english: Placing the mind in the heart, one continues until reaching the transcendent state beyond mind.
